title: Concerns and attempted issue resolution
summary: This topic centers on customer concerns and service conversations about whether issues were identified, explained, or resolved, with many fragments too vague or procedural to show clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention either no fault being found or a concern being manageable in everyday use.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe unresolved technical concerns or service guidance presented as a fix without showing the problem was actually solved.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly brief service or owner comments about concerns, updates, troubleshooting, size, or attempted fixes that do not clearly express satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short and lack enough context to determine clear sentiment.
The topic mixes procedural service-writer language, technical references, and general owner concerns such as vehicle size.
Examples are insufficient to identify a single consistent issue beyond broad concern-and-resolution language.
